note: On the Bay River 25 miles east of New Bern, a short drive from Oriental. Heated bathhouse, dog park, community building, waterfront pavilion, boat ramp, two fishing piers, fish-cleaning station, kayak and pedal-boat rentals; a pool was under construction (website, October 2026). Many guests keep permanent sites (monthly, semi-annual and annual stays). --Claude
summary: Operator site: confirmed 20/30/50-amp full hookups, open year-round, showers/laundry/store/Wi-Fi; added phone reservations. No nightly rate is posted anywhere (rates page has only policies) and there is no booking engine. Phone on the site is (252) 714-3458, not the entry's. Google Maps 4.8 from 167 reviews. Note cleaned of field-duplicated facts.
flags: Long-stay test 2 lead: the park sells monthly, semi-annual and annual stays ('Several of our guests have had a permanent campsite since the campground's opening'; 'Annual Payment Refunds'; 'For monthly and long-term guests, all units must be no older than 10 years. Exceptions are often made based on photos') and posts NO nightly rate and has no booking engine (rates page: policies only; 'Book Now' links to that page). If AWH judges it long-stay in character it fails test 2; otherwise it passes as an ordinary park on presence (website + phone; Google 4.8 from 167 reviews) and the RV Life $$ tier. No site split is published (test 4 passes on silence). https://riversedgefamilycampground.com/rates/
Phone: the operator's site gives (252) 714-3458 for reservations; the entry has 252-559-3603.
